source.citation: Fukuchi RK, Fukuchi CA, Duarte M (2017). A public dataset of running biomechanics and the effects of running speed on lower extremity kinematics and kinetics. PeerJ 5:e3298
source.note: derived summary statistics from the raw marker and force files

method.frame: x forward, y up (plate = 0), metres; stance fractions 0, 5 ... 100 % between the raw 20 N strike and toe-off; COP-based values masked where Fy < 0.2 BW; Fx, Fy, COPx 30 Hz zero-lag per contact (COP held at low force before filtering), markers 15 Hz zero-lag (as landing-fukuchi.js / the forceLine block)
method.variants: lat: lateral malleolus (static Ankle carried by the shank-cluster fit) and lateral epicondyle (Knee); jc: ankle joint centre = midpoint of Ankle and Ankle.Medial, knee joint centre = midpoint of Knee and Knee.Medial (all carried by the cluster fits)
method.shankDeg: angle from vertical of the knee-to-ankle line, positive when the ankle is ahead of the knee (shank leaning backward); shank lean forward = -shankDeg; thighDeg = hip joint centre (Harrington) to knee joint centre; kneeDeg = thighDeg - shankDeg_jc
method.footDeg: Heel.Bottom to forefoot (MT1/MT5 midpoint, or the single marker available) line above horizontal minus the standing value with the same marker choice
method.ankleDF: dorsiflexion change from standing = (-(shankDeg - standing shankDeg)) + footDeg: forward shank lean plus toe-up foot rotation (shank vertical and foot flat in standing is the zero)
method.shankFrame: origin at the ankle point; u = unit vector from ankle to knee (along), p = u rotated by -90 deg (perpendicular; forward when the shank is vertical); the pressure point is (COPx, 0); perp = d.p, along = d.u
method.circle: algebraic (Kasa) least-squares circle through the leg-averaged subject trace (perp, along) at 15-85 % of stance (13 points); rms = rms radial residual; radius also / subject height and / leg length (|GTR-Knee| + |Knee-Ankle| standing, 3D)
method.regression: per subject, copAheadAnkle on sin(-shankDeg) (slope = effective radius, m) and on -shankDeg in radians, over 15-85 % of stance, on the leg-averaged curves; pooled = the 3 speeds together per subject
method.creep: x of a marker + v_belt (t - t_strike) relative to its value at 30 % of stance; v_belt = trial median of the backward speed of the lowest foot marker in mid-stance; creep_0_30 = change from strike to 30 % (forward positive); creep_ho_to = change from heel-off to toe-off
method.footFlat: first stance fraction (1 % grid) at which footDeg is within 2 deg of its median at 40, 45, 50 %; heelOff = Heel.Bottom first 10 mm above its 40-60 % median, after 50 %
method.heights: heelH / foreH = Heel.Bottom / forefoot-midpoint height above its median over 40-60 % of stance (m)
method.displacement: hipDisp / midDisp / comDisp: forward displacement since foot strike relative to straight travel at the stride-mean velocity of the same point (hip = stance-side hip joint centre, mid = midpoint of the two hip joint centres, com = plate-derived COM: integral of the periodic velocity from the stride Fx/m, zero mean velocity); hipMinusMid, midMinusCom, hipMinusCom are differences
method.cohorts: strides -> legs -> subjects as in landing-fukuchi.js; rearfoot = legs whose RFSI/LFSI is "Rearfoot"; subject-level fits are computed on the leg-averaged curves, then averaged across subjects
